name: Aperture
source:
Welcome to Hoshino City, a dystopian, technologically but not morally advanced city. Where corruption runs high and the law enforcement is scarce. Our characters have graduated from high school and are attending a prestigious preparatory school to advance into college, Hoshino Academy of Excellence. Our characters will navigate their ambitions and dreams through the corrupted city.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/vonsatia/about]Patreon[/url]]
